text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That was insanely fast! So much 
power! This is why sprint races are the 
best!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Besides... didn't Nishino Flower's running 
look different from before?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Before, it felt more like 'Whoa, fast!', 
but now, it's like she's gained more 
power. Could she be... evolving—?

Perceptive spectators and critics would 
likely notice the difference in her 
running form. And that trial and error 
will continue. But for now—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There are still some things bothering me, 
but... I think I did everything I could 
do!
choice_data_list: I could feel it even just from watching!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank goodness...
choice_data_list: Sprints shouldn't be a problem, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Indeed. It seems it suits me after all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
For our next target race, should we stick 
to running sprint distances?

Ideally, if she can run slightly longer 
distances, she'll be able to enter more 
graded races and broaden her opportunities 
to shine.

If her body has grown and her abilities 
are expected to improve, it might be a 
good time to try stepping up in distance.

At the press conference after the race, it 
was decided that we would announce Nishino 
Flower's next entry.
choice_data_list: Our next goal is the Milers Cup.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oho, the mile, is it? If we head for the 
Yomiuri Milers Cup, then after that would 
be...
choice_data_list:
I plan to challenge the GⅠ Yasuda Kinen as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Your ultimate goal is indeed a GⅠ race, 
right? Do you also have a vision of taking 
on medium-distance races beyond that?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see... Well, Nishino Flower-san has 
already achieved wonderful results as it 
is.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
If things keep going like this, wouldn't 
both Nishino Flower-san and you, Trainer, 
receive an award from the URA?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list:
I've never even thought about winning an 
award.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, my apologies. Though if both of you 
end up winning the award, please let us 
celebrate it in our media publication as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! Thank you very much.
The press conference ended—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: âAn awards ceremony, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(You're right. Being recognized means... 
you can even win awards. That's truly such 
an honor...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"It must be something really, really 
wonderful... for you too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(How wonderful. I might... just be able to 
create a future for Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(In that case, I'll do my very best... and 
give Trainer an award!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. I just found a new dream...♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found you, Flower-san! Great work 
today!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, Baku—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"And I saw your press conference! Taking 
on the mile... Truly an exemplary goal!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am aiming to conquer about a hundred 
weight classes myself, but alas, right now 
I am in the middle of mastering speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet again in the autumn at the 
Sprinters Stakes! Until then!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: —Shin-o-san...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You're like a swift gust of wind, as 
always. No one could ever call cherry 
blossoms fleeting around you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I suppose so~.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Flower-san, you're challenging the mile 
division as well, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I'm hoping to increase the 
distance little by little.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Little by little...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
……The wall of "distance" is high, and the 
chasm deep. So vast that even a storm 
would falter.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-san...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I will be running in the Milers Cup as 
well. I will become the wind over sprint 
and mile distances, and then—"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I will lead the pack, even across longer 
distances... I will... achieve 
"Three-Division Domination."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Watching your press conference made a 
tempest rage within me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"It seems things have finally quieted 
down, though..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Zephyr-san seemed kind of different 
from usual today."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What could be the matter...?
choice_data_list:
We might figure something out at the 
Milers Cup.

We might figure something out at the 
Milers Cup.

text_block_list.text:
Though Yamanin Zephyr is on my mind, the 
daily training toward our goal begins 
anew.
